title: Supercontinuum in a photonic-crystal fibre
summary: The benchmark of Dudley, Genty and Coen (Rev. Mod. Phys. 78, 1135 (2006), Fig. 3): a 50 fs, 10 kW sech pulse at 835 nm breaks up into solitons in 15 cm of photonic-crystal fibre (soliton number 8.65), the spectrum spans 492 to 1307 nm at -40 dB and the mean coherence over six noise realisations is 0.98.
